$comment: Read by `serve` (npm start), which previews the exported build. Its only job is to send the headers a real deployment sends, so that the local preview behaves like the deployed site. nginx.conf.template and netlify.toml are the deployment equivalents; next dev cannot send these at all, because config headers are unsupported with output: export.

headers.$comment: WebMCP is exposed only to origin-isolated documents. Without this, registerTool() rejects with SecurityError and the page would announce tools no agent can reach.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self'; worker-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
